preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 1 for x in [n, a]) and n % 2 == 0 and a <= n
preconditions.description: n is an even integer ≥ 2, and a is an integer between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum time (in seconds) Vasya needs to reach house a, which is the smaller of the distances from the start to house a on either side of the street (a-1 for odd-numbered side, n-a for even-numbered side).
